Get to know us ↗

Understanding into action

Accept. Include. Empower.

Our mission is to advance education, advocacy, accessibility, and inclusion for autistic and neurodivergent people through practical resources and community collaboration.

01

Education

Make information clearer and build understanding of different ways of thinking and communicating.

02

Advocacy

Support dignity, autonomy, and access, with lived experience helping guide the work.

03

Inclusion

Encourage community connections that respect people’s choices, needs, and boundaries.

Where we are now

A beginning with purpose.

NeuroSpicy Awareness is an independent Oregon public-benefit nonprofit organization. Federal IRS recognition of tax-exempt status is pending.

We are preparing our first community projects and building this website. More information will be shared as resources and programs are ready.
